objectives: Define a tissue and understand the utility of tissues in multicellular organisms.
Differentiate between plant tissues and animal tissues.
Identify types of meristematic and permanent plant tissues.
Identify epithelial, connective, muscular, and nervous animal tissues.

ai_context.learning_goal: To teach students how cells group together to form tissues and perform specific functions in both plants and animals.
common_misconceptions: Assuming plants and animals have the same types of tissues.
Confusing xylem (water transport) with phloem (food transport).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use analogies: Xylem goes UP like an elevator (water from roots), Phloem goes EVERYWHERE (food from leaves).
